entries.def:
ἐπιστήμων, -ον, genitive, -ονoς
(ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: Deu.1.13; 4.6, Isa.5.21 (בִּין ni.), I Est.8.44, Sir.10.25; 21.15, etc. ;] 
knowing, skilled: Jas.3.13.†
(AS)

ἐπι-στηρίζω 
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;] 
to make stronger, confirm: with accusative, Act.14.22; 15.32, 41.†
(AS)

ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; frequently in Mac ;] 
__1. a message. 
__2. a letter, an epistle: Act.9.2, 1Co.5.9, al.; pl., Act.22.5, 1Co.16.3, al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, 2Co.3.1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, Th., 121 ff.; NTD, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.)
(AS)

ἐπι-στομίζω
(στόμα), 
to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: Tit.1.11.†
(AS)

ἐπι-στρέφω 
[very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): Luk.1.16-17 (cf. Mal.3.24), Jas.5.19-20. 
__2. Intrans., 
__(a) to turn, turn oneself around: Act.16.18 with inf., Rev.1.12 before πρός, Act.9.40 so also pass. (cl.), Mrk.5.30; 8.33, Jhn.21.20;…

ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: Ezk.47.7 (שׁוּב), Sir.18.21; 49.2, etc. ;] 
a turning about; metaphorically, conversion (Field, Notes, 246): Act.15.3.†
(AS)

ἐπι-συν-άγω 
[in LXX for אָסַף, קָבַץ, etc. (Cremer, 65) ;] 
__1. to gather together: Mat.23.37; 24.31, Mrk.13.27, Luk.13.34; pass., Mrk.1.33, Luk.12.1; 17.37, (cf. Psa.102.23; 106.47, 2Ma.1.27, al.). 
__2. to gather together against (Mic.4.11, Zec.12.3, 1Ma.3.58, al.).†
(AS)

ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2.7 * ;] 
a gathering together, assembly: Heb.10.25 before ἐπί, 2Th.2.1 (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

ἐπι-συν-τρέχω 
to run together again: Mrk.9.25 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

ἐπι-σύστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπισυνίστημι) [in LXX: Num.16.40 (עֵדָה) Num.26.9 (נָצָה hi.), I Est.5.73 A* ;] 
a gathering, a riotous throng: Rec. (for ἐπίστασις, which see), Act.24.12, 2Co.11.28.†
(AS)
